doubts.claim_under_doubt: S06 holds only when pytest and Playwright each ran at least one test and all passed
doubts.disproof_attempt: After the first fix round S06 accepted passed+skipped===total, so an all-skipped suite (passed 0, skipped 5, total 5) passed.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Require passed > 0 in addition. FIXED in a435f345e with an all-skipped unit case.
doubts.finding: S06 passed an all-skipped suite after the first fix round.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: All passed in S06 means the pytest run succeeded
doubts.disproof_attempt: pytest with 5 passed and 2 errors is recorded passed 5, failed 0, success false; S06 ignored success and exit_code.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Also require success not false and exit_code 0. FIXED in a435f345e.
doubts.finding: S06 ignored the runner success flag and exit code.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Resume lets an operator continue an idle-aborted run
doubts.disproof_attempt: Idle, budget and crash escalations are persisted, so a resumed run can never pass S08.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Document it as fail-closed by design. DONE in a435f345e (README, expected-result).
doubts.finding: A resumed run cannot pass S08; this was undocumented.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: S08 judges the gates the harness answered
doubts.disproof_attempt: The final re-read of gates.jsonl is reachable by the agent under test.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Judge on the start snapshot plus memory. FIXED in a435f345e.
doubts.finding: S08 evidence file reachable by the agent.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: A resumed run skips New pipeline only when the earlier part started it
doubts.disproof_attempt: skipStartPipeline is inferred from the presence of the run config.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Follow-up card (deferred, recorded in the decision drop).

doubts.claim_under_doubt: A resumed run is the only writer of project/
doubts.disproof_attempt: No liveness check of the earlier part's processes.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Documented in the README; a PID lock is a follow-up card.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: The TypeScript unit specs protect the harness in CI
doubts.disproof_attempt: No CI job runs the unit specs or the typecheck; ci.yml is owned by BP.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Follow-up card for BP; the local run is recorded in the evidence.
doubts.finding: TypeScript specs run in no CI job.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: S02 ties a badge to each thread per tab
doubts.finding: S02 not scoped to the tab panel.
